g.text: deviations are distinct quantities. Percentile-initialized bounds expand to all observed points, avoiding

g.text: a logarithmic x axis. Panel c is supplied as two matched standalone views: 2520 E1c activation

g.text: observations, and 280 E7 V-cache plus 112 E20 multi-slot observations. Both show range relative to the

g.text: points (R²=0.861389). The fit is not estimated separately for either view. Insets enlarge the 0.85–1.0
